source: <?php class C{public int $x=1;function make(){return function(){return ++$this->x;};}} $o=new C;$f=$o->make();$g=clone $f;unset($o,$f);echo $g(),$g();
<?php class C{public int $x=4;function make(){return fn()=>$this->x;}} $o=new C;$f=$o->make();$g=clone $f;$o->x=7;unset($o,$f);echo $g();
<?php class A{function make(){return function():self{echo __CLASS__;return $this;};}}class B extends A{}$o=new B;$f=$o->make();$g=clone $f;echo $g()===$o;
<?php class A{function make(){return static function(){echo __CLASS__;static $x=0;return ++$x;};}}class B extends A{}$o=new B;$f=$o->make();echo $f();$g=clone $f;unset($o);echo $f(),$g();
<?php class C{public int $x=1;function make(){return function &(){return $this->x;};}}$c=new C;$f=$c->make();$g=clone $f;$r=&$g->__invoke();$r=7;echo $c->x;unset($c,$f,$g);echo $r;
